question: A sum of Rs 8000 amounts to Rs 9261 in 3 years at compound interest. Find the rate per annum.
trick: Take the cube root of the ratio Amount/Principal.
remember: Know cubes: 21^3 = 9261, 20^3 = 8000 - they appear often in CI questions.

question: Select the odd one out: 121, 169, 225, 290
trick: Check if each number is a perfect square.
remember: Squares up to 30 must be memorised for odd-one-out questions.
